quality.scope: Bellinge combined-sewer study network, Odense, Denmark; original published model, approximately 1.7 km2 study area.

event.observation_kind: DMI climateData hourly acc_precip with validity=true and qcStatus retained; regional airport observations, not Bellinge local gauges.

target.selection: Largest sum of source subcatchment areas directly assigned to the upstream node; positive-length circular conduit; tie by source ID. No result-based tuning.

transformations.physical_parameter_policy: Original hydraulic/hydrologic/control/DWF values preserved except declared zero-area NaN normalization and scenario diameter.

quality.coordinate_reference: Original model XY coordinates preserved. No EPSG assignment or municipal boundary coverage inferred by this adapter.
limits: Historical published neighborhood models, not full municipal inventories or current condition surveys.

No new calibration or field validation. Original Bellinge models are explicitly uncalibrated; Tuindorp was adapted from InfoWorks and originally simulated with SWMM 5.1.015. This experiment uses 5.2.4.
Hourly observations at regional stations, spatially uniform across all source gauges; local convective extremes and spatial variability are unresolved. No synthetic temporal disaggregation.
A 24-hour warm-up from the original empty initialization is a declared convention, not demonstrated hydrologic/sewer equilibrium.
Preserve original ponding differences. Node overflowing volumes can include water that ponds/re-enters; they are not identical to system flooding loss.
Native report node volume resolution is 1 m3. A displayed zero in a listed flooding row is not proof of no overflow.
Overflow volume is not a 2D flood extent, damage estimate, health/safety judgment, current blockage diagnosis or city ranking.
Native warnings and continuity errors remain reviewable. No quantitative forecast, calibration or final-product qualification is admitted.

rounding: Native report node volumes: 0.001 million litres = 1 m3 resolution, ±0.5 m3 per displayed node. Listed rows may display zero. System loss and summed overflowing-node volumes differ with ponding/re-entry and rounding.
